SQLMODEL.SCHEMA_DESCR: VIS_002 — Total Net Book Value KPI card for the Asset/Finance Manager Management Dashboard. Assumption (data availability): no CLOSING_WDV/accumulated-depreciation figure exists anywhere in the currently deployed schema — there is no deployed Depreciation generation/posting/register table, only the rate masters FAM_DEP_RATE_CA_MASTER and FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER (useful-life/rate definitions, not posted WDV lines) — so this card uses a COUNT of currently active assets (a CONFIRMED FAM_ASSET_INSTALLATION record with no matching APPROVED FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL) as an interim volume proxy for 'net book value', i.e. gross installed assets net of approved disposals. Once a Depreciation Register/posting table carrying CLOSING_WDV per asset is deployed, NET_BOOK_VALUE should be swapped to SUM(CLOSING_WDV) as on the latest posted period, joined by ASSET_CODE, keeping the same branch filter shape. This mirrors the same proxy pattern used on the sibling VIS_001 Total Gross Asset Value card. Assumption (FY criterion): FINANCIAL_YEAR is resolved via the server-side system tokens ?.@1stDayOfFinYear/?.@Today (Apr-Mar), always defaulting to the current FY window used to scope 'currently active' assets; it is not exposed as an editable per-tile prompt here — the parent Management Dashboard's own criteria panel is the place to add an overridable FY selector shared across all its tiles. Assumption (branch default): 'logged-in user's branch, selectable All' is implemented as an optional 'like' filter defaulting to '%' (All) with an F2 lookup to FAM_BRANCH_MASTER; wiring the true logged-in-user's-branch default requires a project variable (:user_site or similar) that was not confirmed to exist in this project. Branch is resolved per asset from its latest APPROVED FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER (no branch/location column exists on the asset itself). No sparkline — the FRS specifies a plain Card (unlike VIS_001's Card+sparkline). Drill-through: none specified in the FRS for this tile.

COLUMNS.NAME: NET_BOOK_VALUE
COLUMNS.name: Total Net Book Value
COLUMNS.descr: Interim proxy: count of currently active assets (confirmed installation, no APPROVED disposal on record) — no CLOSING_WDV/accumulated-depreciation column exists yet in the deployed schema (no Depreciation posting/register table is deployed, only the rate masters FAM_DEP_RATE_CA_MASTER/FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER). Swap for SUM(CLOSING_WDV) once a Depreciation Register/posting table carrying WDV is deployed.

COLUMNS.NAME: LBL_HEADLINE
COLUMNS.name: Caption
COLUMNS.descr: Fixed caption under the headline number

SOURCE_SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.asset_code) AS NET_BOOK_VALUE,
  'Total Net Book Value (Active Assets)' AS LBL_HEADLINE
FROM fam_asset_installation i
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT t.to_branch_code
  FROM fam_asset_transfer t
  WHERE t.asset_code = i.asset_code AND t.status = 'APPROVED'
  ORDER BY t.transfer_date DESC
  LIMIT 1
) cur ON TRUE
WHERE i.status = 'CONFIRMED'
  AND i.installation_date BETWEEN ?.@1stDayOfFinYear AND ?.@Today
  AND COALESCE(cur.to_branch_code, '') LIKE ?.branch_code
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fam_asset_disposal d
    WHERE d.asset_code = i.asset_code AND d.status = 'APPROVED'
  )
